answer.camera_language: A stable cabin master gives way to a tightening belongings insert and purposeful walking movement, peaking with the umbrella opening before following Anudi past the food vehicle.
answer.arc: 1 → 1 → 2 → 3 at the rain-driven change → 2 → 2 → 2, an everyday transition rather than a dramatic shock.

clips.motivation: Let the passing windows supply movement while the protected cabin and Anudi's routine remain stable.
clips.opens_on: Wide cabin view with the driver foreground left and Anudi seated rear right, her phone and carried belongings visible.
clips.lands_on: The same wide cabin arrangement, with passing street texture beyond the windows.
clips.composition_note: Seat backs and window frames separate the driver foreground left from Anudi rear right without obscuring her belongings.
clips.why: Establishing 1: a cabin-relative hold expresses her sheltered routine while the moving street provides visible life.
clips.camera_sentence: An eye-level wide view stays fixed across the cabin throughout the journey, keeping the driver foreground left and Anudi rear right as the street passes beyond the windows.

clips.direction: Toward the phone above her lap
clips.trigger: Her right hand continues supporting the phone above her lap.
clips.motivation: Give the phone a clear material presence through a modest but visible tightening without making it a dramatic discovery.
clips.opens_on: Insert of the smartphone diagonally across her right hand above navy trousers.
clips.lands_on: A tighter insert with the phone and supporting fingers filling the frame and less navy fabric visible, its screen still oblique and unreadable.
clips.angle_reason: The downward view follows the seated owner's viewing direction and clearly locates the phone above her lap, without implying diminished power.
clips.composition_note: The handset forms a diagonal through the centre; the supporting right hand remains legible as the tightening frame excludes more navy fabric.
clips.why: Reveal 1: a short, slow push visibly enlarges the phone in her right hand, establishing the belonging without suggesting a startling discovery.
clips.camera_sentence: From a slightly high insert, the camera slowly pushes toward the phone as her hand remains steady, ending with the handset and supporting fingers filling the frame, its screen still oblique.

clips.direction: Right with Anudi's departure from the car
clips.trigger: After her nod, Anudi starts walking screen right.
clips.motivation: Keep the stop and exit spatially stable, then transfer attention from the car to her onward route.
clips.opens_on: Wide pavement view with the arriving car left and centre and the office approach open at right.
clips.lands_on: Wide view with Anudi moving along the pavement at right and the stopped car remaining toward the left edge.
clips.composition_note: Preserve walking space to the right; use only enough pan to retain Anudi without losing the car-door geography.
clips.why: Arrival 2: the frame waits through the practical exit, then a slow rightward pan hands the scene's momentum to Anudi.
clips.camera_sentence: An eye-level wide view holds through the stop and exit, then slowly pans right as Anudi starts walking, settling with her on the pavement and the car at the left edge.

clips.direction: Right, parallel to Anudi from the pavement side
clips.trigger: Anudi is already walking screen right.
clips.motivation: Carry her continuous walk through the rain's arrival while making the occupied hands and umbrella opening readable.
clips.opens_on: Medium-wide three-quarter front view of Anudi with her folded umbrella and both occupied hands visible.
clips.lands_on: The same medium-wide scale beneath the fully open umbrella, with the pavement visibly passing behind.
clips.composition_note: Keep space ahead at screen right and sufficient headroom for the open canopy; retain phone, handbag and umbrella hand in the frame.
clips.why: Transition 3: sustained lateral travel makes the change from phone-led routine to rain management the scene's strongest camera passage without exaggerating it.
clips.camera_sentence: In an eye-level medium-wide view, the camera tracks right alongside Anudi at walking pace as rain begins, keeping her scale constant and ending with her occupied hands below the fully open canopy.

clips.direction: Right with Anudi past the food three-wheeler
clips.trigger: Anudi approaches the food three-wheeler from frame left.
clips.motivation: Follow her route while preserving the food vehicle as a clear geographic reference beside the pavement.
clips.opens_on: Wide roadside view with Anudi under her umbrella at left and the food three-wheeler ahead beside the curb.
clips.lands_on: Wide roadside view with Anudi beyond the food three-wheeler at right and the vehicle shifted toward frame left.
clips.composition_note: Pan only far enough to follow her passage, retaining the food vehicle at left and sufficient walking space ahead.
clips.why: Establishing 2: a measured rightward pan carries forward the walking movement while showing Anudi's precise route past the food vehicle.
clips.camera_sentence: An eye-level wide view slowly pans right as Anudi passes the food three-wheeler, ending with her beyond it at right and the vehicle still visible at left beside the pavement.

clips.direction: Right beside the moving umbrella rim
clips.trigger: The open canopy is already travelling screen right.
clips.motivation: Move with the umbrella so the gathering rain remains legible against a visibly travelling roadside background.
clips.opens_on: Tight insert beneath the canopy edge, its diagonal rim above soft roadside colour.
clips.lands_on: The same rim at constant scale as a bead drops away and the blurred roadside continues moving left.
clips.angle_reason: Looking slightly upward from beneath the rim exposes the hanging droplets against the soft roadside rather than implying authority.
clips.composition_note: Place the rim across the upper third with open blurred space below for the falling bead.
clips.why: Reveal 2: matching the canopy's travel makes the rain tactile without repeating the umbrella opening or inventing emotional emphasis.
clips.camera_sentence: A slightly low insert moves right at the canopy's pace, holding its rim at constant scale as the blurred roadside slides left, ending on the edge as a bead falls.

clips.direction: Backward ahead of Anudi along her rightward route
clips.trigger: Anudi continues walking beneath the open umbrella.
clips.motivation: Stay connected to her face as her attention moves from the phone toward the route ahead.
clips.opens_on: Eye-level close-up of Anudi beneath the canopy, slightly left of centre with the food vehicle soft behind.
clips.lands_on: The same close-up scale with her gaze forward and the roadside receding behind her.
clips.composition_note: Keep her face slightly left of centre with looking room toward screen right, staying on the established pavement side of her route.
clips.why: Transition 2: a steady retreat preserves the walking rhythm while her raised gaze completes the small shift from absorption to navigating the rain.
clips.camera_sentence: In an eye-level close-up, the camera retreats smoothly at Anudi's walking pace as her gaze lifts, keeping her face the same size beneath the canopy while the roadside recedes behind.
